sources.label: Official ARKET GB women's size guide (Clothing: size conversion + body measurement, cm)

audit: Was 6 rows 'XS (EU 34)'–'XXL (EU 44)' with single values, one EU size per letter and US sizes. Official chart is letter sizes XS–L only, each spanning two EU/UK sizes (XS = EU 32–34 / UK 4–6 … L = EU 44–46 / UK 16) with cm ranges (e.g. M chest 92–96, waist 76–80, hip 100–104; old M was bust 90/waist 72/hips 95). No US sizes and no XL/XXL on the official chart.
notes: EU sizing. H&M Group's most premium brand. Timeless, quality-focused. Deliberately relaxed Scandinavian cut. Official chart is letter sizes only: XS = EU 32–34 / UK 4–6, S = EU 36–38 / UK 8–10, M = EU 40–42 / UK 12–14, L = EU 44–46 / UK 16. Runs generously — if between sizes, size down.
